criteria.requirement: Implement tablib.conversion.convert_columns(dataset,converters,*,errors="raise") returning frozen ConversionResult(dataset,errors) and CellError(row,column,error_type,message). Use completed schema/copy semantics and actual raw cells in deterministic row then header order. Converters receive independent cell copies so mutation or late failures cannot affect source. Raise mode wraps ValueError/TypeError/OverflowError with row/name context; collect keeps original failed cell copy and continues while successful conversions survive. Preserve title/tags, reject unknown/noncallable columns and invalid strategies, propagate unrelated programming exceptions and store no traceback.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
